briefing: Markets drifted slightly lower today (NASDAQ -0.6%, S&P 500 -0.2%) with no clear risk-on or risk-off signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) sits below the $500 threshold needed for a new position, and per past lessons we don't force a buy on a neutral day just to deploy capital — holding all 7 positions and waiting for a genuine setup.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: When there's no strong signal and available cash is too small to responsibly size a new position, doing nothing is itself a valid decision. Holding cash isn't wasted capital — it's dry powder waiting for a genuine opportunity, and avoiding a forced trade on a mediocre setup protects you from unnecessary risk.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 當市場沒有明顯訊號、可用現金亦不足以穩健建立新倉位時,「按兵不動」本身就是一個合理的決定。持有現金並非浪費資本,而是等待真正機會的「彈藥」;避免在條件一般時勉強交易,有助減少不必要的風險。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices saw a mild pullback today, with the S&P 500 down 0.2% and the tech-heavy NASDAQ down 0.6%. There was no single dominant catalyst driving the move — it reads as routine, low-conviction profit-taking after recent gains rather than a shift in market direction. Volume and volatility remained unremarkable, consistent with a neutral trading session.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日主要指數輕微回落,標普500指數下跌0.2%,以科技股為主的納斯達克指數下跌0.6%。市場並無明顯單一催化因素,走勢較似是近期升勢後的例行獲利回吐,而非市場方向的轉變。成交量及波動性均維持平穩,符合中性交投格局。
